reading.body:
LightEdge Des Moines 2 sits in Altoona, Iowa, about 25 minutes from Des Moines International Airport, as the second of two LightEdge facilities in the Des Moines area. The operator's public specification page does not display the campus's power capacity or square footage; those figures are available only in a downloadable spec sheet not accessed in this research. Without published IT load, the campus cannot be assessed for compute density or rack count.

Iowa has 52 mapped data center facilities, but only two publish power capacity figures. This campus ranks third among Iowa's published megawatt capacity, though the actual figure is not public. The state's two published facilities total 18 MW. LightEdge operates the only other Iowa facility in this registry's published data.

The campus's role in AI scaling cannot be determined from published specifications. To evaluate whether this site matters to AI, a reader would need to access LightEdge's downloadable spec sheet directly or contact the operator for power capacity and IT load information.
